answer: Burn-on-exit stops sybil churn: each identity must anchor a 60-credit stake to one name, and quitting burns half of it. Exit passes a canyon gate: the stake locks six epochs, and re-entry restarts 14-day maturation at zero weight. Washing 1,000 fakes starts a spiral burning 1,000 × 30 = 30,000 credits per wash, plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000-credit pool. Rented slots fail: the key stays bound. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its share.
